dct_title_s: Satellite detected water extent in Bongor City as of 26 August 2024
dct_description_sm: **UNOSAT code: FL20240820TCD, GDACS ID: 1102854** This map illustrates satellite-detected water extent in Bongor City, Mayo-Boneye Department, Mayo-Kebbi Est Region, Chad as observed from a PlanetScope satellite image acquired on 26 August 2024. Within the analysed area of about 70 km², a total of about 20km² of lands appear to be affected by flood waters. Within the analysed area approximately 1,600 buildings (<30%) in Chad are affected by the floodwaters. This is a preliminary analysis and has not yet been validated in the field. Please send ground feedback to the United Nations Satellite Centre (UNOSAT).
